title: Designing with our logos
slide_intent: Teach designers to preserve the relationship between a symbol and its source. Recognizable circuit pads can give the V in Voltera a meaning specific to printed electronics.
strategic_value: Voltera can carry its circuit-making identity into both the company signature and its product names. Repeating the pad as a spacing unit gives designers a reference for placing the mark.
demonstration: Three printed pads form a V with a blue pad at upper left. The space diagram sits beside four combinations of mark and ground. Two product signatures below add V-One or NOVA after the corporate name.
practical_value: When a title already names the product, use the corporate signature. Use a product signature when the surrounding composition has no other place for that name.
